# Sponsor logo sources

Used in the Bondrail Chainlink CRE demonstration thumbnail to identify actual integrations. Logos remain the property of their respective owners; their inclusion does not assert endorsement or partnership.

- Chainlink white symbol: official brand assets https://chain.link/brand-assets ; downloaded https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f6b7190899f41fb70882d08/6aa7ff155cada44adcd10c02_Chainlink-Symbol-White.png
- Monad symbol: inline SVG labelled Monad Logomark on https://www.monad.xyz/ . Geometry and explicit path fill preserved; rendered locally to PNG. The file name includes white, but the official path retains its purple fill.
- Retrieved 2026-10-13.

- Envio wordmark: official homepage metadata at https://envio.dev points to https://envio.dev/brand-assets/envio-logo-square.png ; downloaded 2026-10-13. Transparent padding cropped for layout; original colors and geometry preserved.
